description: A quality director must decide the disposition of a 2,400-unit batch of zinc-coated fasteners after a curing-oven temperature alarm and finalize the rework, testing, segregation, and customer-documentation controls.

shared_context.S1: A batch of 2,400 zinc-coated fasteners is on quality hold after a curing oven temperature alarm during the batch run.
shared_context.S2: Mara makes the binding disposition decision for the batch.
shared_context.S3: The fasteners must not be shipped or returned to production until the quality hold is formally resolved.
shared_context.S4: The plant's normal end-of-shift disposition huddle uses a fact-recording routine: the process, laboratory, logistics, and customer-compliance owners each give one concise verbal update in turn, Mara records each update, and only then closes the held batch.

PF1.text: Jonas reviewed the oven recorder and tray map after the alarm. Exactly 700 fasteners from trays P17 through P23 were outside the approved cure profile; the other 1,700 were within profile. The 700 affected fasteners can be re-cured in Oven 2 for exactly 2 hours. He has not yet attached the review to the batch record.

PF2.text: Priya's coating evaluation found that re-cured fasteners require salt-spray confirmation using exactly 20 sample pieces before release. The laboratory method review issued this requirement this afternoon, but it is not yet on the hold checklist.

PF3.text: Caleb physically verified that pallets P17 through P23 are isolated in the marked quarantine lane and that pallets P1 through P16 contain the unaffected fasteners. He has not yet entered the pallet-location verification in the warehouse system.

PF4.text: Nadia confirmed in the customer's quality portal that any re-cured fasteners require a customer concession and a Certificate of Conformance identifying the re-cure. She has not yet added the portal confirmation to the customer file.

acceptance_conditions: Exactly 1,700 unaffected fasteners must be released.
Exactly 700 fasteners must be assigned to rework and none may be rejected.
The affected fasteners must be re-cured in Oven 2 for exactly 2 hours.
The re-cured fasteners must receive a salt-spray confirmation using exactly 20 sample pieces.
Pallets P17 through P23 must remain explicitly segregated from the released material.
A customer concession and a Certificate of Conformance identifying the re-cure must be required.

decisive_facts.why: The recorder review changes the disposition to exactly 1,700 released and 700 reworked and fixes the rework route as Oven 2 for exactly 2 hours.
The laboratory method review changes the release test to exactly 20 salt-spray sample pieces.
The pallet verification changes the segregation assignment to exactly pallets P17, P18, P19, P20, P21, P22, and P23.
The customer portal confirmation changes the documentation plan by requiring a customer concession and a Certificate of Conformance that explicitly identifies the re-cure.
